purpose: Authoritative visual design system and Android UI implementation constraints.

authority.principle: The approved Stitch screens are the visual source of truth. Android implementation should reproduce their visual hierarchy and behavior without treating Stitch HTML as the Android implementation.
authority.screen_identity_rule: Use the screen folder identifier as the authoritative screen identity. Do not rely on inconsistent HTML title metadata.

logo.ordinary_header_rule: Use the V symbol rather than the full V4SH wordmark.
full_wordmark_usage: Other places where explicit product identification is appropriate

color_system.source: warm_editorial_upi palette reference supplied by the project.

primary.name: Primary
primary.tonal_direction: Deep burgundy family from the reference palette.

tertiary.name: Tertiary
usage: Cards and controls where specified by the approved screen

neutral.name: Neutral
usage: Background or component surfaces where specified by the approved design

color_system.approved_palette_principle: The palette is intentionally restrained: deep burgundy is the primary identity color, muted brown is the secondary accent, and white is the neutral/light surface base.

dark_theme.rule: Do not introduce a night/dark theme unless the product specification is explicitly changed.

typography.direction: Elegant serif headings paired with clean editorial/body typography.
typography.implementation_rule: If the exact reference font is unavailable natively, choose the closest stable Android-compatible equivalent while preserving the reference hierarchy, scale, weight, and editorial character.

inverted.rule: Use only where the approved screen requires contrast inversion.

search.style: Light neutral field with subtle border.
search.rule: Do not turn search into a dominant visual element.

bottom_navigation.style: Light rounded navigation surface with four primary destinations.

icon_actions.style: Small, restrained icon controls with circular or compact rounded surfaces where appropriate.
icon_actions.rule: Icons should support hierarchy rather than become decoration.

cards.style: Restrained rounded cards with thin borders and soft shadows.

layout.stitch_canvas_rule: Desktop-sized Stitch canvas wrappers are reference artifacts only. Native Android screens must use the actual mobile viewport.

cards.style: Restrained rounded cards with thin borders and soft shadows.
cards.rule: Cards should group related information without turning every element into a floating container.

borders.purpose: Separation and hierarchy rather than decoration.

shadows.rule: Avoid heavy elevation or exaggerated floating effects.

corner_treatment.rule: Do not use excessive pill-shaped containers unless the approved screen clearly calls for one.

bottom_navigation.rule: Do not add, remove, rename, or reorder the four primary tabs without changing the frozen product specification.

header.rule: Do not place a centered V symbol in ordinary screen headers.

primary_action.rule: One clear primary action per state where practical.

destructive_or_risk_states.rule: Use clear semantic hierarchy and wording; do not rely on color alone.

loading.rule: Show an explicit processing state rather than implying success.

home.rule: Keep scanning/payment initiation prominent and avoid unrelated financial-product features.

transactions.copy_boundary: Do not visually imply that this is a complete bank statement.

receive_money.role: Help the user receive money through their existing UPI account.
receive_money.rule: Do not visually imply that V4SH holds a wallet balance.

success.rule: Use success treatment only after definitive confirmation.

failed.rule: Do not use 'Unconfirmed' as the failed-state badge.

unknown.visual_semantics: Payment outcome cannot currently be determined.
unknown.rule: Make the uncertainty prominent and do not visually encourage immediate repayment.

cancelled.rule: Do not imply that V4SH cancelled an already initiated bank transaction.

no_mobile_network.rule: Distinguish network availability from payment success/readiness.

network.avoid: Payment is ready simply because a mobile network is available.

processing.explanation: This only stops V4SH from waiting on this screen. It does not cancel a payment that may already have been initiated.

transactions.rule: Present this as a local V4SH record, not a complete bank statement.

implementation_constraints: Implement the approved mobile layouts natively in Jetpack Compose/Material 3.
Treat Stitch HTML as visual reference only; do not directly ship the exported HTML.
Do not introduce a desktop wrapper into the native Android UI.
Preserve the approved palette and typography hierarchy.
Do not replace the deep burgundy primary with arbitrary Material defaults.
Do not add a dark theme.
Do not add wallet, rewards, offers, bills, recharge, loans, investments, social, or other unapproved financial features.
Do not replace the V-symbol header treatment with a full wordmark on ordinary screens.
